author: Nelev
body:
Follows [#22](https://github.com/TuringCollegeSubmissions/msmacc-AE.AFA.3.5/pull/22). A green light now runs along the heartbeat behind the panel, climbing each QRS spike, disappearing behind the card and coming out the other side.

## Why the trace had to move

It was a `background-image: url("data:image/svg+xml,…")`. A background is a texture — there is no path inside it to travel along and nothing to light up. Inline, the geometry exists **once** and three things share it:

- `<path id="ecg-path">` — the resting trace
- `<use href="#ecg-path">` — the moving light, a 6%-long dash animated with `stroke-dashoffset`
- `<circle>` + `<animateMotion><mpath href="#ecg-path">` — the head dot

`pathLength={1000}` normalises the path, so the dash values are percentages and survive any edit to the waveform. A CSS `offset-path` for the dot would have meant a third copy of the coordinates; `mpath` points at the element instead.

**Six beats in six seconds** — the sweep runs at a resting heart rate.

## Dark by default

The light is dark-only. On porcelain a glow has nothing to bloom into and the sweep reads as a flicker rather than a monitor, so light mode keeps the resting trace alone. With the light gated that way a light-first app would never show it — hence `dark` on `<html>`.

The light tokens stay complete under `:root`. Removing that one class is the whole of the switch back, and the sweep re-hides itself automatically.

**This supersedes "Light is the default" in #22's description and commit message.**

## The reduced-motion trap

The blanket rule in `@layer base` sets `animation-duration: 0.01ms` and `iteration-count: 1`, which does not cancel an animation — it snaps it to the final keyframe. The chaser would have frozen at `dashoffset: 0`, a bright segment parked mid-trace, and the dot stopped wherever `animateMotion` had reached. Both are `display: none` instead, which SMIL needs anyway since it ignores `animation-*` entirely.

## Also

- The two hardcoded stroke colours come out of the data URIs into `--trace-ink` / `--trace-lit`.
- The send control takes the primary the stethoscope mark uses, and the composer's focus ring follows it — a coral ring around a mint button advertised a colour the button no longer was. Coral is now the live dot and `S1` answers only.

## Verified

In the running dev server: `html` carries `dark`, `.ecg-chaser` computes to `display: block` with `animationName: ecg-sweep`, and under light both moving parts compute to `display: none` with the resting trace still drawn. No client JS — `EcgTrace` is a Server Component.

Prettier, lint, typecheck and 23 tests pass.
